heat_pump.notes: Estimated: GT 55 and GT 63 share one powertrain (same 106 kWh pack) in our data; the GT 63 page lists Heat pump: Yes. No page opened for the GT 55 itself. ArenaEV is a spec database with EU figures; "Yes" does not say standard or optional and no Mercedes US/CA page could be opened (media.mbusa.com 404; KBB, Cars.com, Green Car Reports silent). ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional (it also says Yes for the 2019–21 i3, where it was a paid option), and its pages mix EU data.
